pro.basis: Community-measured median weekly allowance about $157 of list-price usage. five_hour 18 is a launch guard (25% launch floor, 12% margin) above the roughly $11-$13 measured per window. No weekly_fable window: Claude Pro includes no Fable allowance.

max5.basis: five_hour from the official 1:4 ratio to Max 20x and the community full-window range ($93-$127); seven_day from the community lower bound for a busiest week that did not hit the cap (about 58% of Max 20x), not 1/4. weekly_fable is half of seven_day, from the published 50% Fable rule.

max20.basis: Measured seven_day $2,380 (0.27%/h), five_hour $376 (1.71%/h); community medians run lower ($1,602 weekly, $263 per 5h) for lighter workloads. weekly_fable is half of seven_day, from the published 50% Fable rule.

max.basis: Plan tier not reported as 5x or 20x; falls back to the smaller Max 5x prior.

plus.basis: Community panel: 27 full weekly cycles, median $67 per week (range $61-$81). Burn assumes about $10 per worker-hour.

team.basis: Team seats use the same per-seat allowance prior as Plus.

pro100.basis: Community panel: median $175 per week, about 2.6x Plus rather than the advertised 5x. Burn assumes about $10 per worker-hour.

pro.basis: Prior for the 10x allowance in force from 2026-10-30 (previously 20x): community conversion about $351 per week, half of the earlier measurement about $287; 325 sits between. Re-measure after a full cycle.

ultra20.basis: Google AI Ultra 20x. USD figures are a routing scale, not billed USD, derived from measured percentage burn (about 0.62%/h of the weekly Gemini pool, 2.1-2.2%/h of the 5h pool) and an assumed worker-hour cost; community estimates are about $800 per week and $200 per 5h. The 3p rows are an unmeasured placeholder for an independent pool. The same values are the fallback in allocator.window_capacity_usd.

ultra5.basis: Google AI Ultra 5x. Only the 5h allowance ratio (1/4 of Ultra 20x) is published; capacity is the Ultra 20x routing scale divided by four and burn is multiplied by four for the smaller pool.

pro.basis: Google AI Pro. Only the 5h allowance ratio (1/20 of Ultra 20x) is published; capacity is the Ultra 20x routing scale divided by twenty and burn is multiplied by twenty for the smaller pool.

ultra.basis: Ultra tier not reported as 5x or 20x; falls back to the Ultra 20x prior.
